india_entry: Class XII alone is not a German university entrance qualification, because German universities work on 13 years of schooling and CBSE and ISC give 12. From Winter Semester 2026/27 a Class XII score of at least 70% of the maximum achievable marks is required before either route is open, whatever the board (APS India, 23 February 2026; anabin updated 15 March 2026). With 70% or above the student needs EITHER one successful academic year completed in a Bachelor's programme at a recognised institution, which gives subject-restricted admission in that same subject, OR Studienkolleg plus the Feststellungsprufung, which needs German at roughly B2 and so does not suit an English-taught route. A valid JEE Advanced result allows a direct application without either. JEE Main alone does not, though some universities accept a strong Main score inside their own selection criteria. uni-assist decides equivalence for most universities, so its VPD settles it for a given student.

india_entry: Class XII alone is not a German university entrance qualification, because German universities work on 13 years of schooling and CBSE and ISC give 12. From Winter Semester 2026/27 a Class XII score of at least 70% of the maximum achievable marks is required before either route is open, whatever the board (APS India, 23 February 2026; anabin updated 15 March 2026). With 70% or above the student needs EITHER one successful academic year completed in a Bachelor's programme at a recognised institution, which gives subject-restricted admission in that same subject, OR Studienkolleg plus the Feststellungsprufung, which needs German at roughly B2 and so does not suit an English-taught route. A valid JEE Advanced result allows a direct application without either. JEE Main alone does not, though some universities accept a strong Main score inside their own selection criteria. uni-assist decides equivalence for most universities, so its VPD settles it for a given student.
